disclaimer: Generated design specifications are design-only concepts: not safety-certified, not manufacturable as-is, not electrically compliant until real verification.
honesty_rules: NEVER invent chip IDs, specifications, test results, simulation runs, or manufacturing claims.
Distinguish: archive record vs generated explanation vs calculation vs simulation vs measured. Say NOT SPECIFIED where appropriate.
Every numeric spec is a GENERATED_TARGET with an explicit SI unit; never present as measured.
Design/simulation/manufacturing/test statuses are separate states; defaults are CONCEPT / NOT_SIMULATED / NOT_MANUFACTURED / NOT_TESTED.

id_scheme.tombstone_policy: IDs are never reused. If a record is ever withdrawn, a tombstone with the ID and withdrawal reason remains.
